```lean
theorem lg_target (n : ℕ) : ¬ 3 ∣ n ^ 2 + 1 := by
  intro h
  cases h with q hq
  have hq' : n^2 + 1 = 3 * q := hq
  rw [hq'] at hq
  have h1 : n^2 ≡ -1 mod 3 := by rw [hq]; exact mod_eq_of_div_eq_mul hq
  have h2 : n^2 ≡ 0 mod 3 ∨ n^2 ≡ 1 mod 3 := by exact_mod_eq_iff_or
  cases h2 with h2a h2b
  · rw [h2a] at h1
    have h3 : 0 ≡ -1 mod 3 := by rw [h1]; exact mod_eq_of_div_eq_mul h1
    contradiction
  · rw [h2b] at h1
    have h3 : 1 ≡ -1 mod 3 := by rw [h1]; exact mod_eq_of_div_eq_mul h1
    contradiction
```
